# Progeni Atlas — Autonomous AI Technical Interviews & Skills Evaluation

> Progeni Atlas is an enterprise-grade autonomous AI technical interview and skills assessment platform. It conducts live, two-way neural voice and video interviews, evaluates multi-language coding tasks in real-time sandbox environments, enforces non-intrusive anti-cheat proctoring, and automatically generates calibrated recruiter scoring dossiers.

## Core Capabilities
- **Autonomous Two-Way Voice Interviews**: Live conversational AI interviewer with sub-second voice latency that dynamically adapts questions based on candidate responses, resume context, and job specifications.
- **In-Browser Multi-Language Coding Sandbox**: Real-time terminal execution for Python, TypeScript, JavaScript, C++, Go, and Java with unit-test validation and algorithmic complexity analysis.
- **Anti-Cheat Proctoring & Companion Mode**: Dual-camera verification via smartphone pairing, gaze alignment detection, voice biometric verification, and copy-paste telemetry without intrusive spyware.
- **Calibrated Candidate Dossiers**: Server-authoritative scoring across Core Technical Competency, Architecture & System Design, Problem Solving, and Communication.
- **Duration-Based Wallet Billing**: Transparent accounting convention where ₹1.00 = 1 Credit, with screening billed at 1 Credit per 3 minutes (₹0.33/minute). Every new organization receives 2 complimentary trial demo screenings of up to 10 minutes each.
- **Enterprise ATS Integration**: Real-time webhook and API sync with Greenhouse, Workday, Lever, and custom applicant tracking systems.

## Key Technical Tracks
- **Full-Stack Development**: React, Next.js, Node.js, REST/GraphQL APIs, database modeling, and state management.
- **Backend Systems Engineering**: High-throughput distributed services, caching architectures, database indexing, and async task pipelines.
- **Frontend Architecture**: Modern UI frameworks, rendering performance, bundle optimization, accessibility, and design system engineering.
- **DevOps & Site Reliability (SRE)**: Containerization, Kubernetes, CI/CD orchestration, infrastructure as code, and observability.
- **AI & Machine Learning Engineering**: Model fine-tuning, embeddings, vector search (Qdrant), LLM orchestration, and RAG evaluation.
- **Data Structures & Algorithms**: Algorithmic problem-solving, graph traversal, dynamic programming, and space-time complexity analysis.

## Pricing & Rate Cards
- Convention: ₹1.00 INR = 1 Credit
- Rate Card: 1 Credit per 3 minutes (0.33 Credits/min)
- Free Demo Screening: 2 complimentary screenings (up to 10 minutes each) for newly registered recruiter organizations
- Payment Integration: Instant 24/7 UPI & QR gateway ("Progeni Atlas", UPI: progeniatlas@ptaxis)
